author: nurhayatdev
text: CISA has added critical CVE-2026-111497 to KEV. The out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder can corrupt memory and potentially enable RCE when an app decompresses attacker-controlled Brotli data. Brotli 1.0.3-1.2.0 is affected; update to 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

text: Openwave Webtop vulnerability CVE-2026-111793 is exploited in the wild, per JPCERT/CC. Upgrade Webtop Media Transcoder to 1.1.22.0 or later.

text: The shai-hulud payload distributed via Ruby package strutil-core surfaced in at least 14 GitHub repos over the weekend, inserted into backdated commits. The payloads contain the agent injection instructions from the Ruby package.

text: GitBook said 'AI agents' hit its infrastructure: on 2 November an attacker gained unauthorized access to GitBook, the documentation platform; its post-mortem walks an identity chain and names no agent.
